answer: Each voting key must bind to one exclusive, deliverable civic address and lock a slashable bond. The protocol mails a registered nonce there; only a timely signed return of that exact token confers weight. Bindings go on a public cedar register, so a reused address is obvious. A hollow mailbox that never accepts delivery, a late or substituted token, or two keys sharing one address slashes every linked deposit and voids the ivory delivery receipt. Fielding N identities needs N deliverable addresses, N successful mailings, and N immobilized bonds, so presence and capital scale with farm size.
